source_policy: release 2026.11.12b-local-flaw-delivery: local flaws no longer restore a whole PDF page to its source (imperceptible raster drift tolerated in the final formula audit; allowlisted local structure warnings are delivered and recorded; an element that fails rendering alone keeps its exact source ink); distribution watermark codes are removed at extraction by a narrow detector; translations that would leak an internal placeholder token, or that change a numeric row's numbers, are not drawn; prompts, configuration and caches unchanged
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
tests, test requirements and release tooling (kept in the source repository)
validation: Local regression suite: 955 passed, 2 skipped (Python 3.13, constraints.txt, PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3), including tests for the formula drift tolerance, local structure warnings, element-level render fallback, distribution watermarks, placeholder token leaks and the numeric row guard, each condition checked by mutation; an offline, keyless reassembly of six real production jobs on the production host: four complete with no source page, one keeps only the two pages of a cross-page sentence in source, one unchanged; three review rounds by two independent reviewers.
